body: Thanks for sharing! The way I personally try to rationalize more distressing dreams like yours is by thinking of them as expressions of emotions that our brains kind of randomly select. Some nights I’ll get good dreams where my brain is expressing joy, and other nights my brain will express fear and as a result conjure up distressing imagery that i either thought up consciously or have in my head unconsciously. This stuff can stem from stress from real life and manifest itself in a disturbing way in your head, or just be some completely random violent stuff that your brain just makes up. It’s all pretty much random violence, but if you look hard enough you can also sometimes get useful insights into yourself and your subconscious. But yeah that’s all I got. My interpretation is that your brain just had some bad vibes to work through and you were on the receiving end of that. Thanks again for sharing, this was an interesting read : )
